intentions.title: Ship a full Excel-compatible spreadsheet document type (type:"sheet") with multi-tab sparse cells, A1 addressing, and a formula engine covering 60+ functions with Excel-faithful precedence, error propagation, and cross-tab dependency cycles
intentions.evidence: engine.ex moduledoc documents full grammar (arithmetic, refs, ranges, Tab! qualifiers), unified {tab,col,row} dependency graph for cross-tab #CYCLE! detection, and an extensive function library (SUM/IF/VLOOKUP/HLOOKUP/date funcs/text funcs/etc.); core.ex parse_ref/format_ref A1 helpers; grid bounded at XFD/1,048,576 matching Excel limits

intentions.title: Keep the Sheets plugin fully optional — documents still render correctly with the plugin off via a pre-synthesized dense snapshot embedded in the portable-doc block
intentions.evidence: core.ex moduledoc: 'the snapshot is what keeps documents rendering with the Sheets plugin off (fresh-install invariant)'; Content write-through refreshes snapshot on every mutation; @snapshot_schema_version gates backfill/rehydration; session.ex also states sessions work with the plugin off, only the HTTP ops route is plugin wiring

intentions.title: Support real-time, low-latency collaborative cell editing via a lazily-started per-sheet GenServer session that serializes ops, debounces persistence, and survives session churn without double-applying retried batches
intentions.evidence: session.ex: DynamicSupervisor + SessionRegistry keyed by {dataset,published-id}, hibernate/idle-stop lifecycle, ≤1000 ops/call cap, debounced persist (2s/25-ops); replay_ring.ex: exactly-once ETS ring outside the session process specifically because a retry can land on a freshly-restarted session

intentions.title: Give users a full spreadsheet grid editor's worth of structural operations (insert/delete rows+cols, merges, freeze panes, tab management, sort) with Excel-correct formula-reference rewriting on every structural change
intentions.evidence: session.ex documents insert_rows/delete_rows/insert_cols/delete_cols, set_frozen, rename/add/delete/move/duplicate_tab, merge_cells/unmerge_cells, sort_range; delegates ref-shift semantics to structure.ex ('dead refs become #REF!', merges shift/clip/drop)

intentions.title: Round-trip spreadsheets losslessly through xlsx import/export, including number formats, conditional formatting, and merged cells, so Barkpark can serve as a real interchange point with Excel/Sheets
intentions.evidence: fmt.ex: two-way numFmtId<->semantic class mapping engineered so canonical export strings classify back to the same class ('fmt survives a sheet → xlsx → sheet round trip exactly'); xlsx_import.ex/xlsx_export.ex; csv.ex/markdown.ex/html.ex additional export formats; export_controller.ex serves .xlsx/.csv/.tsv/.md/.html

intentions.title: Provide server-side conditional formatting so every surface (Studio, exports, embeds) renders identical cell styling with zero cross-surface drift
intentions.evidence: cond_format.ex moduledoc: 'evaluated SERVER-SIDE into the snapshot styles map during synthesis... so every surface that honors styles shows the same formatting with zero cross-surface drift (arc-2 decision CF-D1)'; gate-strict write-time validation vs lenient total evaluation at render time so a malformed rule never 500s a snapshot

intentions.title: Never lose or corrupt in-flight edits: bound and document every durability tradeoff (debounce window, replay ring cap/TTL, node-local ETS) rather than pretending sessions are perfectly durable
intentions.evidence: session.ex: 'On a NON-graceful BEAM death... up to debounce_ms/flush_after_ops worth of acknowledged-but-unpersisted ops are lost by design'; replay_ring.ex: 'Bounds (accepted residuals)' section explicitly documents cap/TTL/node-local/at-least-once gaps as deliberate, not fixed
